brand.notes: The client asked for Midnight Blue and Burgundy with no hex codes. Chosen values: midnight blue #13254A (main), burgundy #7B1E2F (accent), ivory #F7F3EC (light bands), muted gold #C9A96E (leaf mark and small details on dark), deep navy #0B1733 (dark bands). No font was given, so the template default pair is used. No logo was supplied (the CSV says one needs designing), so a simple oak leaf mark with a 1Oak / FINANCIAL GROUP wordmark was built: public/images/logo.svg, logo-white.svg, logo.png.
